_doc: Methodology for contract/on_transformation.json — Felix-style long-form thesis with embedded viz. Not rendered; consumed by deploy-on-transformation-agents skill and style_check. Mirrors ai-transformation.fyi/on-transformation anatomy.

reference.grammar: Scrolling essay + sticky Contents nav + roman-numeral chapter kickers (I · …) + subheads as argument clauses + chart captions as thesis claims

heading_voice.kicker: Chapter titles: roman numeral + em-dash clause. Argue, don't label. Bad: 'EXPOSURE'. Good: 'II · HOW LARGE IS THE BET'.
heading_voice.toc: Match kicker text without ALL CAPS — readable in sticky nav.
heading_voice.subhead_h: Inside sections: short verb phrases ('Four moves from trigger to settlement', 'Register-native pricing').
heading_voice.flow_steps: Named moves in a chain, not one-word labels ('The interrupt', 'Size the bet', not 'Trigger', 'Measure').
heading_voice.tabs: Transformation close: wedge / levers / market fragments.

register.model: Transformation thesis: index as wedge, not product; close on cover that does not exist yet.
register.viz_rule: Every quantitative claim in prose must have a matching viz block in the same or next section.

felix_moves: Wrong question first — market prices damage; peril is availability
Two-axis tension before the single number (Exposure × Preparedness → MoS)
Universe on one scatter — the whole population visible
MoS must correlate with something measurable (measured share regression)
Transformation close — fragments exist, full stack does not
Honest provisional — eval gate visible on thesis page
